mapper.select: select position_no AS positionNo, position_name AS positionName, priority, company_no AS companyNo from POSITION where company_no=#{companyNo} order by priority asc
mapper.delete: DELETE from POSITION where position_no=#{positionNo} and company_no=#{companyNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POSITION(position_no, position_name, priority, company_no) VALUES ('P' || LPAD(SEQ_POSITION_NO.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), #{positionName}, #{priority}, #{companyNo})
mapper.select: select rank_no AS rankNo, rank_name AS rankName, priority, company_no AS companyNo from RANK where company_no=#{companyNo} order by priority asc
mapper.delete: DELETE from RANK where rank_no=#{rankNo} and company_no=#{companyNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RANK(rank_no, rank_name, priority, company_no) VALUES ('RK' || LPAD(SEQ_RANK_NO.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), #{rankName}, #{priority}, #{companyNo})
